title.zh: 授权为菲律宾国家粮食与农业组织（FAO）委员会的运作与维护拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds for the Operation and Maintenance of the Philippine National Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) Committee
title.orig: An Act Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds for the Operation and Maintenance of the Philippine National Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) Committee

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1960/ra_2656_1960.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, there is hereby authorized to be appropriated the sum of one hundred thousand pesos for the operation and maintenance of the Philippine National Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) Committee: Provided, That the operation and maintenance of the said committee shall include the payment of the following:
1. Salaries and wages of personnel. The members of the Committee, except the chairman, executive secretary and assistant executive secretary, are not members of the personnel.
2. Traveling expenses including travel abroad and per diem of personnel and members of the Committee designated by the proper authority to represent the Philippines in international meetings and conferences sponsored or co-sponsored by the FAO.
3. Meal allowance for members of the Committee during Committee meetings including members of the personnel provided such meal allowance does not exceed ₱5.00 for each member of the Committee attending personnel.
4. Representation expenses for the entertainment of visiting FAO official, FAO specialists and scientists.
5. Illumination, telephone, postal, telegram, cable and radio services.
6. Purchase and repair of furniture and equipment.
7. Purchase of supplies and materials.
8. Printing and binding of publications.
9. Rental of building.
10. Miscellaneous services.

The appropriation herein authorized shall be provided for in the subsequent annual General Appropriations Act: Provided, However, That any unexpended balance of the appropriation herein authorized at the end of the fiscal year immediately prior to the fiscal year wherein the necessary appropriation for this purpose has been included in the annual General Appropriations Act shall revert to the General Funds.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1960.
